review_items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact 508c74784d3344ada2c0e266a36b63ed version 1, its retained harness and plan, claim C_prepare_vballot_preserved version 1, and raw events from CheckRun 35b34756363847b183b2d3913113dbea. The duty is local preservation of the producer-reported value tag across the typed PrepareReply transport. It is grounded in the declared separate Ballot/VBallot fields, handlePrepare copying inst.vbal, and handlePrepareReply comparing VBallot to select prior supported metadata. This does not require assuming the consensus algorithm is correct. The consumer establishes relevance; it is not executed by this check.

The prefix uses actual handlePropose at origin 1 in N=5,F=2,Thrifty=true state. That creates slot 1.0 at ballot 1 and broadcasts PreAccept through actual SendMsg/Marshal to preferred peers 0 and 2. Each receiver obtains a fresh object through its RPC table and dispatches the decoded message. These paths establish nonzero vbal=1 with PREACCEPTED_EQ status. Their replies toward origin 1 remain pending, so no commitment is presumed. Replica 2 then calls the actual recovery entry on its known uncommitted slot, generating Prepare ballot 7 through makeBallot and bcastPrepare. Replica 0 decodes that actual request, and runtime checks verify both the established nonzero tag and a higher request ballot before handlePrepare runs. The test does not synthesize a PrepareReply or write value tags directly.

Initialization is bounded empty-state construction for the used fields, with the same IDs, count, failure parameter, thriftiness, Dreply and RPC registration order as the actual constructors. Replacing peer writers by bufio.Writer over bytes.Buffer retains actual framing and codecs. New/Unmarshal is the production receiver mechanism; byteReader prevents artificial read-ahead effects. Direct serial dispatch exercises a legal local handler prefix with intact one-message frames on the inspected links. No ordering reversal, duplication or fabricated old traffic is used. Recovery is explicitly invoked rather than waiting for the execution watcher: this omits trigger timing, not a data eligibility check in startRecoveryForInstance. The report-preservation duty applies to this actual handler-produced request/reply regardless of a numeric recovery delay. Exec and unrelated services are not run, and no application-completion or automatic-wakeup assertion is made. Buffer capacity 16 is adequate for sole slot 0. No target code or dependency was modified.

The oracle compares decoded_vballot with sent.reported_vballot. The latter is an observed scalar copied from the actual instance immediately before handlePrepare; source shows handlePrepare raises bal but does not change vbal, then copies that same vbal into its outgoing report. The after-handler stored_vballot diagnostic is also 1. All state, buffers, calls and samples have one test-goroutine owner, so this is a coherent observation without a shutdown or concurrent mutation. report_sent is emitted only after the checked prefix and actual synchronous reply write; report_decoded is emitted only after successful registered decoding. Its event fields are read from the decoded object. Admission alias sent and the identity fields scenario, acceptor, origin, instance and requester associate the one produced message with the one decoded result independently of the compared tag. There is exactly one operation, one prerequisite and one result. Missing decode would fail setup rather than be represented as a false tag or a passing comparison.

Raw events show acceptor 0, origin 1, instance 0, requester 2 in both records. The producer reports value tag 1, stored promise 7, status 2 and 58 framed bytes. The receiver reports decoded value tag 0, promise 7, status 2, successful decoding and zero remaining bytes. The retained monitor has no parsing errors, matches prerequisite index 0 to result index 1 and evaluates the complete comparison as violated. Process tests_passed means the experiment completed; it does not mean the property held. The source cause agrees with the observation: PrepareReply.Marshal and Unmarshal omit VBallot and New allocates a zero-valued object. No later reconstruction exists between decode and the registered channel dispatch. Preserved promise and status therefore do not negate loss of the distinct value tag.

Counterevidence is retained: an original zero value tag would survive coincidentally; another message type, PreAcceptReply, does serialize its value tag; request-ballot guards still operate. None substitutes for preservation of PrepareReply.VBallot in this nonzero witness. No correspondence issue was found for the scoped local violation. This review does not confirm a different chosen command, disagreement, permanent stall, full-message fidelity, or any crash-restart consequence.

formation.explanation: Client proposals allocate an origin-row instance and preaccept with dependency/sequence attributes from conflict indexes. Acceptor preaccept reports are filtered by the coordinator attempt and phase; replies merge attributes. The configured fast threshold with equality/commit-prefix/initial-ballot conditions commits; otherwise an Accept phase uses acceptOKs+1>N/2. Commit broadcasts full commands and dependencies; receivers install only when not already committed and not below their promise. Execution waits for dependency availability/commitment, traverses SCCs, executes and responds through retained client proposals. Actual formulas and absent status changes are observations requiring validation, not assertions of quorum sufficiency.

context.explanation: Authority is scoped to origin-row/instance and ballot, not one global log leader. startRecovery replaces bookkeeping, retains proposals, chooses an attempt ballot, retags its local entry and includes a self report before Prepare broadcast. Remote Prepare raises only the promise bal and reports vbal separately. Coordinator accepts matching-attempt replies while preparing, waits for SlowQuorumSize including self, selects by VBallot, then installs committed data, resumes Accept, or restarts phase1. Old requests below a local promise are dropped/reported without replacement; old reply ballots and finished phases are filtered. Same-ballot reuse and preservation of value tags through codecs are open local anomalies.

connection.explanation: Recovery reports are the bridge from prior formation to authority transfer: promise Ballot qualifies the new attempt, while VBallot and Status decide which existing support the new coordinator uses. Commit/execute states constrain overwrite and skip ordinary recovery. Pending proposals survive bookkeeping replacement and may be requeued on own-row NOOP commit. The execution watcher can solicit recovery for missing/uncommitted known work; master selection only influences makeBallot through IsLeader. Wire decoding lies directly on the report path and must be investigated before treating reported value tags as preserved. No unread persistent recovery mechanism is assumed to repair it.

formation.explanation: Client proposals allocate an origin-row instance and preaccept with dependency/sequence attributes from conflict indexes. Acceptor preaccept reports are filtered by the coordinator attempt and phase; replies merge attributes. The configured fast threshold with equality/commit-prefix/initial-ballot conditions commits; otherwise an Accept phase uses acceptOKs+1>N/2. Commit broadcasts full commands and dependencies; receivers install only when not already committed and not below their promise. Execution waits for dependency availability/commitment, traverses SCCs, executes and responds through retained client proposals. Actual formulas and absent status changes are observations requiring validation, not assertions of quorum sufficiency.

context.explanation: Authority is scoped to origin-row/instance and ballot, not one global log leader. startRecovery replaces bookkeeping, retains proposals, chooses an attempt ballot, retags its local entry and includes a self report before Prepare broadcast. Remote Prepare raises only the promise bal and reports vbal separately. Coordinator accepts matching-attempt replies while preparing, waits for SlowQuorumSize including self, selects by VBallot, then installs committed data, resumes Accept, or restarts phase1. Old requests below a local promise are dropped/reported without replacement; old reply ballots and finished phases are filtered. Same-ballot reuse and preservation of value tags through codecs are open local anomalies.

connection.explanation: Recovery reports are the bridge from prior formation to authority transfer: promise Ballot qualifies the new attempt, while VBallot and Status decide which existing support the new coordinator uses. Commit/execute states constrain overwrite and skip ordinary recovery. Pending proposals survive bookkeeping replacement and may be requeued on own-row NOOP commit. The execution watcher can solicit recovery for missing/uncommitted known work; master selection only influences makeBallot through IsLeader. Wire decoding lies directly on the report path and must be investigated before treating reported value tags as preserved. No unread persistent recovery mechanism is assumed to repair it.

items.rationale:
Reviewed fixed artifact 508c74784d3344ada2c0e266a36b63ed version 1, its retained harness and plan, claim C_prepare_vballot_preserved version 1, and raw events from CheckRun 35b34756363847b183b2d3913113dbea. The duty is local preservation of the producer-reported value tag across the typed PrepareReply transport. It is grounded in the declared separate Ballot/VBallot fields, handlePrepare copying inst.vbal, and handlePrepareReply comparing VBallot to select prior supported metadata. This does not require assuming the consensus algorithm is correct. The consumer establishes relevance; it is not executed by this check.

The prefix uses actual handlePropose at origin 1 in N=5,F=2,Thrifty=true state. That creates slot 1.0 at ballot 1 and broadcasts PreAccept through actual SendMsg/Marshal to preferred peers 0 and 2. Each receiver obtains a fresh object through its RPC table and dispatches the decoded message. These paths establish nonzero vbal=1 with PREACCEPTED_EQ status. Their replies toward origin 1 remain pending, so no commitment is presumed. Replica 2 then calls the actual recovery entry on its known uncommitted slot, generating Prepare ballot 7 through makeBallot and bcastPrepare. Replica 0 decodes that actual request, and runtime checks verify both the established nonzero tag and a higher request ballot before handlePrepare runs. The test does not synthesize a PrepareReply or write value tags directly.

Initialization is bounded empty-state construction for the used fields, with the same IDs, count, failure parameter, thriftiness, Dreply and RPC registration order as the actual constructors. Replacing peer writers by bufio.Writer over bytes.Buffer retains actual framing and codecs. New/Unmarshal is the production receiver mechanism; byteReader prevents artificial read-ahead effects. Direct serial dispatch exercises a legal local handler prefix with intact one-message frames on the inspected links. No ordering reversal, duplication or fabricated old traffic is used. Recovery is explicitly invoked rather than waiting for the execution watcher: this omits trigger timing, not a data eligibility check in startRecoveryForInstance. The report-preservation duty applies to this actual handler-produced request/reply regardless of a numeric recovery delay. Exec and unrelated services are not run, and no application-completion or automatic-wakeup assertion is made. Buffer capacity 16 is adequate for sole slot 0. No target code or dependency was modified.

The oracle compares decoded_vballot with sent.reported_vballot. The latter is an observed scalar copied from the actual instance immediately before handlePrepare; source shows handlePrepare raises bal but does not change vbal, then copies that same vbal into its outgoing report. The after-handler stored_vballot diagnostic is also 1. All state, buffers, calls and samples have one test-goroutine owner, so this is a coherent observation without a shutdown or concurrent mutation. report_sent is emitted only after the checked prefix and actual synchronous reply write; report_decoded is emitted only after successful registered decoding. Its event fields are read from the decoded object. Admission alias sent and the identity fields scenario, acceptor, origin, instance and requester associate the one produced message with the one decoded result independently of the compared tag. There is exactly one operation, one prerequisite and one result. Missing decode would fail setup rather than be represented as a false tag or a passing comparison.

Raw events show acceptor 0, origin 1, instance 0, requester 2 in both records. The producer reports value tag 1, stored promise 7, status 2 and 58 framed bytes. The receiver reports decoded value tag 0, promise 7, status 2, successful decoding and zero remaining bytes. The retained monitor has no parsing errors, matches prerequisite index 0 to result index 1 and evaluates the complete comparison as violated. Process tests_passed means the experiment completed; it does not mean the property held. The source cause agrees with the observation: PrepareReply.Marshal and Unmarshal omit VBallot and New allocates a zero-valued object. No later reconstruction exists between decode and the registered channel dispatch. Preserved promise and status therefore do not negate loss of the distinct value tag.

Counterevidence is retained: an original zero value tag would survive coincidentally; another message type, PreAcceptReply, does serialize its value tag; request-ballot guards still operate. None substitutes for preservation of PrepareReply.VBallot in this nonzero witness. No correspondence issue was found for the scoped local violation. This review does not confirm a different chosen command, disagreement, permanent stall, full-message fidelity, or any crash-restart consequence.
